description: This file defines functions and types for managing elbow arrow elements, including path routing, segment handling, and geometric calculations for a diagramming tool.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the grid used for pathfinding with A* algorithm.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: Represents the grid used for routing, containing nodes at grid intersections.

classes.name: ElbowArrowState
classes.description: Holds the state of an elbow arrow, including position and bindings.

classes.name: ElbowArrowData
classes.description: Contains data necessary for calculating the path of an elbow arrow, including bounds and element hover states.

methods.name: updateElbowArrowPoints
methods.description: Updates the points of an elbow arrow element based on user interaction or programmatic changes.

methods.name: getElbowArrowData
methods.description: Retrieves data needed to calculate the path of an elbow arrow, including bounding boxes and element hover states.

methods.name: routeElbowArrow
methods.description: Generates the path for an elbow arrow using grid-based pathfinding.

methods.name: calculateGrid
methods.description: Calculates a non-uniform grid for pathfinding based on bounding boxes and start/end points.

methods.name: getDonglePosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the routing dongle based on bounds and heading.

methods.name: estimateSegmentCount
methods.description: Estimates the number of segments needed between two nodes based on their headings.

methods.name: getNeighbors
methods.description: Returns neighboring nodes for a given grid coordinate.

methods.name: gridNodeFromAddr
methods.description: Retrieves a grid node from grid coordinates.

methods.name: pointToGridNode
methods.description: Finds a grid node corresponding to a global point.

methods.name: commonAABB
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box that encompasses multiple bounds.

methods.name: generateDynamicAABBs
methods.description: Creates dynamic, touching bounding boxes for path routing.

methods.name: getBindableElementForId
methods.description: Retrieves a bindable element by ID from the elements map.

methods.name: normalizeArrowElementUpdate
methods.description: Normalizes arrow points and segments, ensuring they are within bounds and properly aligned.

methods.name: getElbowArrowCornerPoints
methods.description: Simplifies elbow arrow points by removing unnecessary corners.

methods.name: removeElbowArrowShortSegments
methods.description: Removes short segments from arrow points to simplify the path.

methods.name: neighborIndexToHeading
methods.description: Converts neighbor index to a heading direction.

methods.name: getGlobalPoint
methods.description: Calculates the global position of a point, optionally snapping to elements.

methods.name: getBindPointHeading
methods.description: Determines the heading direction for a binding point based on element positions.

methods.name: getHoveredElement
methods.description: Gets the element currently hovered over at a specific point.

methods.name: gridAddressesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two grid addresses are equal.

methods.name: validateElbowPoints
methods.description: Validates that elbow points are either horizontal or vertical and not too close.
